hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: The accumulated price sum of numbers 1 through num is monotonically increasing with num.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Use binary search on num up to 10^15.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: For a given num, calculate the number of set bits at positions divisible by x using block periodicities of powers of two.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search on answer combined with O(60) bit block summation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through every number up to 10^15 causes severe time limit exceeded.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize monotonicity of bit sum and apply binary search over answer.
